calendarFaqs.q: Is this the official HCPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: MySchoolDates is an independent reference based on calendar files published by Henderson County Public Schools. HCPS is the source of record for revisions, school-specific schedules, and weather changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Which HCPS calendar applies to my student?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the calendar assigned by your school or program. This page follows the Traditional and Early College calendar; families on the Flex schedule should use the official Flex calendar linked below.

calendarFaqs.q: When do HCPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students on the Traditional and Early College calendar return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Winter Break ends December 31. Students are also off January 1 for New Year's Day and January 4 for an optional teacher workday.

calendarFaqs.q: When are HCPS early dismissal days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The Traditional and Early College calendar lists early dismissal at 12:00 noon on December 18, 2026 and on the last student day, May 21, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When are HCPS teacher workdays in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar lists optional teacher workdays August 3–4, October 9, January 4, January 18, and May 26–28. Required teacher workdays are August 5–11, October 12, November 3, February 19, and May 24–25. These are no-school dates for students on the Traditional and Early College calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Can weather change the HCPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. HCPS states that the school calendar is subject to change and may be extended for inclement weather. Check district announcements after a closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official HCPS calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: The downloads section links the official Traditional and Early College, Flex, and Spanish calendar PDFs, plus separate Traditional and Flex Child Care calendars. The ICS file on this page is a one-time import for the main Traditional and Early College student-calendar dates.
